task: Depacketize a crafted 3GPP timed-text RTP payload (gpac RTP/RTSP input path): gf_rtp_parse_ttxt reads an advertised ttu_len count of bytes from the payload without checking it against the actual buffer size, reading past the buffer end (OOB read). Single file src/ietf/rtp_depacketizer.c; external reporter credit.
